purpose: First 100M-500M milestone; exact architecture target for an owner-run, rights-cleared pilot. Planning profile only until the gated training command completes.

tokenizer.limitation: Byte-level tokens waste context on Turkish UTF-8. Do not promote this profile to a quality claim or production default; a reviewed subword tokenizer and matching Rust runtime are required for the next quality stage.

hardware.note: These are conservative planning targets, not a guarantee. The trainer estimates memory and blocks before allocation if estimated use exceeds 80% of detected available memory. CPU training may be very slow.

caveats: Exact parameter count is computed from the current trainer architecture; CI checks the declared count.
FP32 inference weights alone are about 533 MB (507.9 MiB), before runtime overhead; training needs much more memory for gradients, optimizer state and activations.
The current local machine's previously reported 3.9 GiB total RAM is not a reliable place to start this profile without a fresh availability check; use the preflight and do not bypass it.
The training corpus must be locally supplied and pass the existing source-register, provenance, split, hash, human-review and privacy gates.
A training run has not been performed by committing this profile.
